text:
Maria: Quick sync — after yesterday's launch I want to propose a clean split of the follow-on backlog: regressions, must-fix UX, and enhancements with launch criteria for each. Thoughts?

Devon: +1. Can we get counts? want to see scope before committing to sprints.

Maria: I pulled numbers: regressions=7 (2 critical), UX polish=5, enhancements=18. Proposal: push the 2 critical regressions into Sprint N+1 as P0, UX polish mostly N+1 as P1, enhs into N+2. Suggest gating some enhancements by beta customers.

Sam: Do we have customer-priority mapping? cc @Kevin for CS signals.

Kevin: From CS side — the two critical ones are reported by paying customers (INC-489, INC-491). Both cause completion failures for specific prompts. I'll attach transcripts and urgency.

triage-bot: Automated triage: INC-489 labeled regression, severity=high; INC-491 labeled regression, severity=high.

Elaine: For grooming, let's block a 1h slot tomorrow. Agenda: confirm owner, estimate, QA path, rollback plan. Also propose we define explicit "must-fix" criteria; otherwise everything drifts to top.

Maria: Draft criteria: must-fix = incorrect output, data loss, major latency regression (>2x), or blocks primary customer flow. UX polish = visual/flow friction not data loss. Enhancements = new features or non-blocking improvements.

Devon: SGTM. For rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with automated regress detection. Use model fallback if we see token-level regressions.

Sam: Owners? I propose @Devon owns critical bug #1, @Elaine owns critical bug #2.

Kevin: :thumbsup: I'll flag the impacted customers and ask for acceptance criteria for the UX items so we can validate fixes.

Maria: Grooming checklist (proposal):
```
- Confirm owner
- Repro steps
- Acceptance criteria
- Tests needed (unit/integration/e2e)
- Rollout plan + fallback
- ETA
```
Anyone add to this?

Elaine: Add 'customer impact note' and explicit 'QA verification steps' to the checklist.

Devon: I'll add estimates tonight. Also can we freeze experiments while we patch criticals? I recommend yes — no model/param changes during the hotfix.

Sam: Agree on experiment freeze for hotfix window. Also need infra to confirm deployment windows.

triage-bot: Deployment window note: next available maintenance slot 03/25 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Maria: I'll schedule grooming 03/22 10:00 PST. If we agree: I'll create tasks and set priorities: P0 critical regressions, P1 UX, P2 enhancements.

Kevin: Approve. Also please prep CS comms templates for customers impacted.

Devon: One more note — some enhancements are cheap perf wins (small model changes or cache tweaks) mark those as 'quick wins' and bump them up in P2.

Sam: On monitoring — add evaluation checks on prompt sets used by customers (automated evals) before and after patch to detect quality regressions.

Maria: Good call. I'll capture notes + action items after grooming. Action items: @Devon write estimates, @Elaine own critical bug, @Kevin prepare customer comms, @Sam confirm infra window. I'll create the thread tracker and tasks.

Maria: :white_check_mark: thanks all
